rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 2026年3月に約3,400万ドルで買収し、データセンター接続向け半導体の製造拠点を得た
relations.text_en: Bought for about $34 million in March 2026, adding fabs for data center interconnect devices

source.label: Semtech 10-K(2026年1月期)
source.quote: On March 3, 2026, we completed the acquisition of HieFo Corporation in an all-cash transaction representing a total purchase consideration of approximately $34.0 million (the "HieFo Acquisition").

relations.text: IoT通信のSierra Wirelessを買収(買収資金に約8.95億ドルを借入)
relations.text_en: Acquired IoT connectivity maker Sierra Wireless, funded partly with $895 million of term loans

source.label: Semtech 10-K(2026年1月期)
source.quote: In the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2023, we borrowed term loans in an aggregate principal amount of $895.0 million under the Term Loan Facility in order to fund a portion of the consideration for the Sierra Wireless Acquisition and related fees and expenses.

relations.text: MACOMが10-Kで、主な競合の一社としてSemtechを挙げる
relations.text_en: MACOM names Semtech among its significant competitors

source.label: MACOM 10-K(2026年9月期)
source.quote: While we compete with a wide variety of companies, our significant competitors include, among others , ADI, Broadcom, Credo, Marvell, MaxLinear, Microchip, NXP, Semtech, Skyworks and Sumitomo as well as increased competition from Chinese companies.

companies.name: モノリシック・パワー・システムズ

relations.text: MPSが10-Kで、主な競合の一社としてSemtechを挙げる
relations.text_en: Monolithic Power names Semtech among its primary competitors

source.label: Monolithic Power Systems 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: We consider our primary competitors to include Analog Devices, Infineon Technologies, NXP Semiconductors, ON Semiconductor, Power Integrations, Renesas Electronics, ROHM Semiconductor, Semtech, STMicroelectronics and Texas Instruments.

companies.name: アルファ・アンド・オメガ・セミコンダクター

relations.text: AOSが10-Kで、電源ICの主な競合の一社としてSemtechを挙げる
relations.text_en: AOS names Semtech among major competitors for its power ICs

source.label: Alpha and Omega Semiconductor 10-K(2026年6月期)
source.label_en: Alpha and Omega Semiconductor 10-K (FY ended Jun 2026)
source.quote: Our major competitors for our power ICs include Monolithic Power Systems, Inc., ON Semiconductor Corp., Richtek Technology Corp., Semtech Corporation, Texas Instruments Inc. and Vishay Intertechnology, Inc.

relations.text: MaxLinearが10-Kで、主な半導体の競合の一社としてSemtechを挙げる
relations.text_en: MaxLinear names Semtech among its primary merchant semiconductor competitors

source.label: MaxLinear 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary merchant semiconductor competitors include Broadcom, Inc., Qualcomm Incorporated, Realtek Semiconductor Corp., Skyworks Solutions, Inc., Credo Semiconductor Inc., MediaTek, Inc., Marvell Technology Group Ltd., MACOM Technology Solutions Holdings, Inc., Texas Instruments Incorporated, Analog Devices, Inc., Renesas Electronics Corporation, Microchip Technology Inc. and Semtech Corporation.

relations.text: Littelfuseが10-Kで、電子部門の競合の一社としてSemtechを挙げる
relations.text_en: Littelfuse names Semtech among competitors of its Electronics segment

source.label: Littelfuse 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In the Electronics segment, the Company's competitors include Eaton Corporation, Bourns Inc., TDK, ON Semiconductor Corporation, Infineon Technologies, STMicroelectronics NV, Semtech Corporation, and Vishay Intertechnology Inc.

relations.text: Airgainが10-Kで、主な競合の一社としてSierra Wireless(Semtech)を挙げる
relations.text_en: Airgain names Sierra Wireless (Semtech) among its major competitors

source.label: Airgain 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The competitive landscape has consolidated significantly, and major competitors include Cisco Systems, Cradlepoint (Ericsson), Digi International, Ezurio (Laird Connectivity), Huawei, Inseego, Lantronix, Nextivity, Nokia, Peplink, and Sierra Wireless (Semtech).

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
